name: arremate
description: Arremate: casa de leilões online com lances ao vivo e histórico de lances auditável (desafio técnico Elite Dev / Verzel).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @arremate/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @arremate/shared" "npm run dev -w @arremate/api" "npm run dev -w @arremate/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @arremate/shared && npm run build -w @arremate/api && npm run build -w @arremate/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @arremate/shared && npm run test -w @arremate/api && npm run test -w @arremate/web
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @arremate/shared && npm run typecheck -w @arremate/api && npm run typecheck -w @arremate/web
